usageNote:
“Al pedo” for nothing, a waste of time, money or effort. “En pedo” drunk. “Ni en pedo” no way, not even if I was drunk. “Agarrarse un pedo” lit. “to grab yourself a fart”; to get drunk.

“De pedo” by chance. “A los pedos” lit. “to the farts”; to go very fast. “Pedorro” lit. “farty”; shitty, of poor quality.

“Vivir en nube de pedos” lit. “living in a cloud of farts”; to be out of touch with reality. “Subo como pedo de buzo” “to go up like a scuba diver’s fart”; generally used in reference to climbing the social ladder.

La Vida Regida por los Pedos
0–20 años: se vive al pedo
20–40 años: se vive a los pedos
40–60 años: se vive en pedo
60–80 años: se vive de pedo
80–100 años: ¡ni en pedo!

Also: “pedo con caldo”, lit. “fart with broth.”

boludo/a [m,f] lit. someone with large testicles; not used to describe someone who is brave or ‘ballsy’; used alike for men, women and children, 1) fool, idiot; 2) used as a meaningless interjection or casually among friends “¡che boludo!” could be anything from ‘you idiot!’ to ‘hey buddy’ depending on the context of the situation.

hacerse el boludo [v] to play dumb, to act as if you don’t know.

buenudo/a [adj] someone who is kind of dumb or naive but a good person.
